flow:
One scanner, eight parts, read as one game from the table to the crosstable. Marcus Landry (2014) beats Priya Shah (1803), a junior with a guardian link, on Board 6 of Round 4 of the Louisiana State Championship 2026, Open section, on Sun, Sep 6. The sample moves stay Morphy's Opera Game finish, 17. Rd8#, as on the boards; the boards' "3 of 5 scans left" is sample data and is redrawn as the real limit, 20 (DAILY_SCAN_LIMIT = 20 in /home/user/lca-website/functions/api/scan/index.ts line 15, counted per member per UTC day in /home/user/lca-website/migrations/0035_scan_usage.sql).

Part 1, GETTING IN AND CAPTURE. After the game Marcus picks up the TD-table card from the printed kit (part 8) and scans its QR, or opens Tournaments > Scoresheet scanner from the phone's Menu sheet (WS02, /home/user/lca-website/docs/redesign/REDESIGN_SPEC.md line 392; the footer's Play column, line 395; the route /scanner in /home/user/lca-website/src/App.tsx line 89). Signed out he sees today's explainer and "Log in to scan" (SignInPrompt in /home/user/lca-website/src/pages/ScannerPage.tsx, state from /scanner). Signed in, the step strip from Scan-A heads the page (Photo · Read · Check · Save & share) with "17 of 20 scans left today · members only" in words, the privacy line, and for a guardian "Whose game is this? You · Priya" (children are profiles, D13). The camera opens with the gold guide frame on the dark camera ground, "Sheet found · hold still", Upload and Back side beneath, up to 3 pages (MAX_PAGES = 3, ScannerPage.tsx line 153; each page one scan today), the bottom tab bar hidden (hideTabBar lists scanner capture, REDESIGN_SPEC.md line 392). On a laptop it is a drop zone with Choose a photo and the page strip; a pre-printed LCA sheet's QR opens /scanner?sheet=<token> with event, round, board and names filled. State between: pages chosen on the phone, nothing has left it yet; at the limit the camera is closed and the count says so; offline, the pages wait on the phone.

Part 2, THE READING JOB. "Scan this sheet" shrinks the photo in the browser (downscaleImage, 1568px long edge) and creates a job: POST /api/scan/jobs, progress from GET /api/scan/jobs/:id (WS15). The contract holds: the reading step transcribes exactly what is written, crossed-out moves and all, and never corrects (RawScan in /home/user/lca-website/src/lib/scanner/types.ts; /home/user/lca-website/scanner/SCANNER_SPEC.md section 2.3); the TypeScript chess.js decoder alone applies legality, in a Web Worker on whichever device opens the job (/home/user/lca-website/src/lib/scanner/decoder.ts, decodeInBackground.ts); npm run scanner:check keeps passing. Stages in words: Found the move grid (US Chess style sheet · 1 page) · Read the handwriting (17 moves · result 1-0) · Checking every move is legal (move 9 of 17) · Matching names to the Round 4 pairings. "You can leave this screen. The draft waits in My games." Marcus pockets the phone and goes to the prize ceremony. States between: in line, reading, checking, matching, done; unreadable, busy or down (the scan is handed back, nothing counted, as releaseScan does today); offline mid-job (the job runs on, the draft waits); a draft row "Reading · started 3:40 PM" in My games.

Part 3, REVIEW: PHOTO, MOVES AND BOARD, WITH THE GAME CHECKS. At 8:00 PM at home Marcus opens the draft from My games on the laptop (the phone would have shown it the moment reading ended). The scoresheet photo with the move under review highlighted on the sheet itself, the move list in scoresheet columns with labels in words beside their colour (Fixed automatically · Check this · You checked), the board at the selected move, the header matched from the pairings ("Marcus Landry 2014 vs Priya Shah 1803 · Louisiana State Championship 2026 · Open · Round 4 · Board 6 · Sun, Sep 6 · names and colours matched from the pairings"), and the game checks under the list: every move is legal in order, no position repeated three times, the written result against the final position ("17. Rd8# is checkmate, which matches the result written on the sheet, 1-0"; ½ never .5). State: "Check · 1 move left" in the step strip, Save and Export closed (WS15 acceptance 3).

Part 4, FIXING A MISREAD. 13...Rxd7 is flagged: the crop of that cell from the photo ("smudged on the sheet"), the board after 13. Rd7, the candidates ranked by whether the later moves still work with a reason each ("Rxd7: fits every move that follows"; "Qxd7: legal here, but then 15. Bxd7+ would capture nothing"), "Something else? Type the move" (looseSan and legalMovesAt in today's MoveEditor), Confirm, Skip for now, Undo last change. A fix keeps everything before it and works the rest out again in the browser (forcedSans in decoder.ts; fixMove and history in ScannerPage.tsx). State: all checked, "Every move checked", Save and Export open.

Part 5, SAVE, SHARE AND EXPORT, WITH THE PRIVACY RULES. Who can see it, in words: Only me · Anyone with the link · Public (scanned_games.visibility private, unlisted, public, WS15); whose game; "Keep the scoresheet photo with this game" (otherwise the source photo is deleted after 30 days, WS15). Save to My games (POST /api/games) gives the share link louisianachess.org/g/landry-shah-r4 with its final-position preview (/og/game/:slug.png), Copy link, Open in lichess (lichessAnalysisUrl in /home/user/lca-website/src/lib/scanner/export.ts), Download PGN, Copy PGN, Email and the phone's share sheet with the PGN file (navigator.share, today). Had Priya's guardian scanned the same game for her, it would be filed under Priya's profile, Only me by default, and the two sharing choices disabled with "Sharing a junior's game needs a guardian's OK" until the guardian allows it (WS15 privacy; D13). State: saved and private, or shared by choice.

Part 6, MY GAMES. The row appears under My LCA › My games (GET /api/me/games, MyGamesPage.tsx in WS15): "vs Priya Shah · won · Louisiana State Championship 2026, Round 4, Board 6 · Sun, Sep 6 · Anyone with the link · Checked". There are no player pages (D9), so this is the only list of a person's games; a guardian sees each child's games under the child's first name, family-only. State: the game is kept, reachable on any device, with Review, Share, Download PGN, Who can see it and Delete.

Part 7, INTO THE TOURNAMENT. Because the event is in the system, the game is tied to its tournament_games row (round, board, section, white and black member ids, result; /home/user/lca-website/migrations/0003_roles_and_directors.sql). "Link this game from both players' Round 4 results (W12 and L3)" makes the game public, since the crosstable is public (a guardian's OK first for an under-18); Priya's guardian is told and can hide the game from her row; both cells in the crosstable (/home/user/lca-website/src/areas/live/components/Crosstable.tsx) gain "Game" in words. A result that differs from the sheet is shown in words and sent to the TD; the player never changes a result (replan 3.1). The event's results page can carry a Key game block chosen by the event's TDs or an LCA admin from the linked games; the Recap tab (replan 3.6 and 4.3) keeps no game and at most a text link to it. The TD's bulk scan is the same pipeline from the other side: the stack of Round 4 sheets, each matched to its board by the printed sheet's QR or by the names, read and checked like any scan, a board grid in words (Scanned and checked · 2 moves to check · No sheet yet · Couldn't match), the read result entering the Reported results queue as "Scoresheet says 1-0 · Confirm" and never writing tournament_games.result (replan 3.1; the queue in 4.6), and both players finding the game in My games. End state: a checked game, saved privately, shared by choice, on both players' crosstable cells with its result cross-checked by the TD.

Part 8, THE PRINTED NOTATION KIT. The front of the loop: the scan-ready LCA scoresheet printed from the pairings with its typed header and sheet-ID QR (a "Scoresheets" option beside pairings, alpha, standings and crosstable in /home/user/lca-website/src/pages/TournamentPrintPage.tsx), the kids' notation cheat sheet that ends at the scanner, and the two cut-out cards (the TD-table card whose QR started this story, and the photo-tips card). Learn the code, write the game, scan it, check it, keep it, link it.

Signed out, the page keeps today's shape from /home/user/lca-website/src/pages/ScannerPage.tsx: the explainer, the How it works rail and the Log in to scan card (state from /scanner, Create an account beside it), with the rules visible before login: members only, up to 20 scans a day, the photo line. Signed in, Scan-A's step strip heads the page at every width (Photo · Read · Check · Save & share) with the count in words, "17 of 20 scans left today · resets at midnight" (DAILY_SCAN_LIMIT = 20 in /home/user/lca-website/functions/api/scan/index.ts line 15; the boards' "3 of 5" is sample data and is redrawn as 20), the privacy line, "Directors: scan a whole round" for anyone requireTournamentManager admits, and for a guardian "Whose game is this? You · Priya", because children are player profiles without a login (D13). On a phone the camera: the gold guide frame on the dark camera ground (gold never as text on a light ground), "Sheet found · hold still", a shutter as well, Upload from the library, Back side or next page up to 3 pages (MAX_PAGES = 3, ScannerPage.tsx line 153; each page one scan today), a strip of the chosen pages with Remove, and the bottom tab bar hidden (hideTabBar lists scanner capture, REDESIGN_SPEC.md line 392). parts.name: The reading job and its progress
parts.what: Reading becomes an async job: POST /api/scan/jobs creates it (members only, claims a daily scan), GET /api/scan/jobs/:id reports progress (WS15). The contract is unchanged: the reading step transcribes exactly what is written, crossed-out moves and all, and never corrects (RawScan in /home/user/lca-website/src/lib/scanner/types.ts; the parser in /home/user/lca-website/functions/utils/scan/rawScan.ts; /home/user/lca-website/scanner/SCANNER_SPEC.md section 2.3); the TypeScript chess.js decoder alone applies legality, in a Web Worker on whichever device opens the job (/home/user/lca-website/src/lib/scanner/decoder.ts, decodeInBackground.ts); pages are read together and joined (mergePages.ts) before the legality pass; npm run scanner:check keeps passing. Stages in words, each ticked as it finishes: Found the move grid ("US Chess style sheet · 1 page") · Read the handwriting ("17 moves · result 1-0") · Checking every move is legal ("move 9 of 17") · Matching names to the Round 4 pairings (only for an event in the system) · Ready to check ("1 move"). The line "You can leave this screen. The draft waits in My games" is what lets a player pocket the phone at the venue and finish at home. OPTION 1, "Moves stream in": Scan-B screen 2 as drawn, the photo above a growing scoresheet-shaped move list with "9...?" flagged as it is read and the four stage rows beneath; hands straight over to the review when done. OPTION 2, "Hand-off": one quiet card with the four stages, the dimmed photo and "This usually takes 10 to 30 seconds" (today's working stage, ScannerPage.tsx line 282), nothing streams; the moment the upload lands the job is a "Reading" row in My games and the page offers "Scan the next sheet" at once; an email ("Your game is ready to check") and a My LCA to-do arrive when it finishes, so a player with three sheets photographs them all between rounds. Calmer for a child watching, less to render on a weak venue connection.
parts.entry: Automatically after Scan this sheet on the capture screen; reopened from a "Reading · started 3:40 PM" row in My games on any device, or from the ready email's link, while it runs.
parts.states: Loading: the stage list with the current stage named; "Your scan is next" while the reader is busy. Unreadable: "We couldn't read this sheet" with the sheet notes ("Page 2 couldn't be read", "a shadow crosses rows 20 to 26"); the scan is handed back (releaseScan, functions/api/scan/index.ts line 47), the count does not drop; Try another photo. Busy: "The scanner is busy. Please try again in a minute" (today's 503 for the model's 429 or 529), Try again keeps the photo. Down: "The scanner is unavailable right now" (502), nothing counted. Session expired (401): log in again, no retry. Descriptive notation detected: "algebraic notation only" (detectDescriptive in decoder.ts). Read but no legal game: "No moves could be worked out" with the decoder's warnings. Partly decoded: "The rest of the sheet couldn't be matched to legal moves, so the game stops here" (truncatedAtPly). Offline mid-job: the job keeps running on the server; "Connection lost. The reading continues and the draft waits in My games"; polling resumes. Limit: refused before upload with the endpoint's words; a running job finishes. Privacy: the photo is held for the job, or 30 days (open for K); the draft row is private to the member.
parts.built_from: Scan-B screen 2 (Reading), with today's working, unreadable and error stages from ScannerPage.tsx folded in.

parts.name: Review: photo, moves and board, with the game checks
parts.what: The checked game with the photo, the move list and the board linked: tap a move anywhere and the other two follow, the move's cell highlighted on the sheet itself (a crop box per ply from the reading step) with a "Show what we read" toggle (Scan-A panel 1). The move list is scoresheet-shaped (White and Black columns) with three labels in words beside their colour: "Fixed automatically" (decoder status corrected: "7. Qb3 was read as Qb8, which isn't a legal move there; Qb3 is the only legal match, so it was fixed without asking"), "Check this" (flagged or guessed) and "You checked" (user-fixed); today's legend in ScannerPage.tsx (Check this move · Read differently from the sheet · Fixed by you) maps onto them. Chips: All moves 17 · Needs a look 1 · Fixed automatically 1. The game details line: players, ratings, result, event, section, round, board and the weekday date ("Sun, Sep 6"), "names and colours matched from the pairings" when the event is in the system, Edit game details for a club night. The board at the exact selected position (fenBefore per move) with first, back, forward and last. Game checks in words with a tick or a warning: every move is legal in order; no position repeated three times; the written result against the final position ("17. Rd8# is checkmate, which matches the result written on the sheet, 1-0", or "The sheet says ½-½ but the last move is checkmate; check the result"). Save and Export unlock only when every "Check this" is resolved (WS15 acceptance 3). OPTION 1, "Three panes": photo left, moves centre, board right on a laptop (Scan-A as drawn); on a phone three tabs, Photo · Moves · Board, sharing one selected move, with the board sticky at the top while a flag is open. OPTION 2, "Sheet as the list": the photo is the main view at every width with the read moves typed over each cell and a colour plus a word per cell (Check this); tapping a cell opens a strip beneath it with the read move, its label and the board beside (laptop) or in a bottom sheet (phone); the typed column list is a drawer. Better for a parent comparing with the handwriting, and the photo stays large on a phone; worse for a long game.
parts.entry: Automatically when the reading job ends on the same device; from a "Needs a check" or "Checked" row in My games on any device (the laptop that evening); from the TD's board grid ("Board 6 · 1 move to check"); from a saved game's own page, owner only, by Review.
parts.states: All clear: no flags, every check ticked, "Every move checked. Nothing to fix", Save and Export live at once. Flags open: "Check · 1 move left" in the step strip; Save and Export disabled with "Resolve 1 flagged move to save". Loading: a skeleton with the board's space reserved. Game cut short: "We could follow the game to move 24. Keep the first 24 moves, or fix move 25" (truncatedAtPly). Result mismatch: written 1-0 but no mate, "Keep 1-0 as written", since resignations happen. No header read: names blank, Edit game details opens. No photo (a draft reopened after the photo expired, or a game saved without it): the photo pane reads "Photo not kept", the sheet highlight is off, moves and board still work. Offline: review and fixes run in the browser (the decoder is client-side), so all of it works; Save waits. Privacy: the owner's only; a guardian opens a child's review from the child's row.
parts.built_from: Scan-A panels 1, 2 and 4, and today's Results, MoveList and MoveCell in ScannerPage.tsx.

parts.name: Fixing a misread
parts.what: Settling one flagged move: the crop of that cell from the photo ("written \"b5\"", "blank on the sheet" or "smudged on the sheet"), the board after the previous move, and the candidates ranked by whether the following moves still work, with the reason each fails: "Rxd7: fits every move that follows" first, then "Qxd7: legal here, but then 15. Bxd7+ would capture nothing", "Nxd7: legal here, but then 15...Nxd7 has no knight left" (Scan-A panel 3; Scan-B screen 3's "h5: legal, but 10. Nxb5 would capture nothing"). "Something else? Type the move" with the legal-move finder (looseSan, "nf3" finds Nxf3+, and legalMovesAt, as in today's MoveEditor). Confirm re-decodes everything after it with forcedSans (decoder.ts line 45) and keeps the earlier fixes; Undo last change (today's history); Skip for now leaves the flag open; "Cut the game here" for a move nobody can read. OPTION 1, "One check per screen": "Check 1 of 2", one flag per screen, "Confirm b5 · next check", until "All checked" (Scan-B screen 3 as drawn); a wizard a child and parent can walk at the table; opens by itself after reading when flags exist. OPTION 2, "Fix in place": any cell in the move list opens the candidate panel beside the board, flagged or not, so a player can also change a move the decoder was sure of; the flags are a filter, not a queue (Scan-A panel 3 and today's cell editor); faster with many flags on a laptop. The two share one component (FlagResolver.tsx in WS15); WS15 pairs them by width, and K may pick one for both.
parts.entry: A "Check this" cell or the Needs a look chip in the review; the step strip's "Check · 1 move left"; the reading job's hand-off when flags exist (on phones the wizard opens by itself in option 1).
parts.states: Empty: "Nothing to check", with the list open for free edits. Re-decoding: "Updating the rest of the game…" over a dimmed list with role=status (today), under a second on a laptop, about 1 second on a time-pressure sheet (/home/user/lca-website/scanner/STATUS.md). Failure: "Couldn't update the game. Please try that move again" with Undo. No candidate fits: "None of these fit the next moves. Type what was played, or cut the game here". Typed move not legal: "No legal move matches \"Qb8\"". Skipped: the flag stays, "1 skipped", Save closed. Many flags (a time-pressure sheet; STATUS.md reports 52% game accuracy there): "Check 1 of 9" with "Fix in the list instead". Undo available or none. Offline: works, as the decoder is in the browser; Save waits for a connection. Privacy: none beyond the review's.
parts.built_from: Scan-B screen 3 (Fix flagged moves) and Scan-A panel 3, with today's MoveEditor, fixMove and Undo from ScannerPage.tsx.

parts.name: Save, share and export, with the privacy rules
parts.what: The finish, once every flag is resolved (WS15 acceptance 3). Who can see it, in words: Only me · Anyone with the link · Public (scanned_games.visibility private, unlisted, public in WS15); whose game (you or a child profile); "Keep the scoresheet photo with this game", otherwise the source photo is deleted after 30 days (WS15), shown as "Photo kept until Thu, Nov 12" or "Photo not kept". Save to My games (POST /api/games) gives a share slug and a link that previews the final position with the players and result (GET /og/game/:slug.png; GET /api/games/:slug applies the visibility rules), Copy link, Open in lichess (lichessAnalysisUrl in /home/user/lca-website/src/lib/scanner/export.ts), Download PGN and Copy PGN (gameToPgn), Email (emailGameLink), the phone's share sheet with the PGN file (navigator.share, ScannerPage.tsx line 550), today's "Copy & open chess.com" (line 670, open for K), and Scan the next sheet. PGN headers carry Event, Site, the date, Round, Board, White, Black, Result. Privacy: an under-18's game (a profile with an active guardian link, D13 and D15) is Only me by default and the two sharing choices are disabled with "Sharing a junior's game needs a guardian's OK" until the guardian allows it from their own My LCA; a teen's own login sees "Ask a parent to publish"; the owner can set a game back to Only me at any time and the link stops working. OPTION 1, "Choose then save": nothing is stored until the person picks who can see it and taps Save; Scan-A panels 5 and Share & export side by side on one finish card, with export allowed without saving, as today. OPTION 2, "Draft first": the game is saved as a private draft the moment reading finishes (needed anyway for the hand-off in part 2), the done screen reads "Game saved · In My games · only you" with the final board (17. Rd8#), then lichess · PGN · Share link beneath, and sharing is a switch on the saved game (Scan-B screen 4 as drawn).

parts.name: My games
parts.what: The member's own library at /me/games under My LCA (WS15 names MyGamesPage.tsx and GET /api/me/games), one tap from the scanner. There are no public player pages (D9), so this is the only place a person's games are listed. Each row: the opponent, the result in words (won · drew · lost), the event or "Club night", round and board, the weekday date ("Sun, Sep 6"), who can see it in words (Only me · Link · Public), a small final-position thumb, and the state in words beside its colour: Reading · Needs a check (2 moves) · Checked · Shared · On the crosstable. Per game: Review (the part 3 screen in read mode), Share, Download PGN, Who can see it, Hide from the crosstable, Delete (DELETE /api/games/:id; a game on a crosstable is unlinked first; Delete removes the photo at once). parts.name: Into the tournament: the crosstable, the key game, the recap line and the director's round scan
parts.what: How a checked game reaches the event, from both sides. Matching: when the sheet's event, round and board (the printed sheet's QR, Edit game details, or names and round matched to the pairings) match an event in the system, the game is tied to its tournament_games row (tournament_id, round, board, section, white_member_id, black_member_id, result; /home/user/lca-website/migrations/0003_roles_and_directors.sql) and the names and colours come from the pairing.
